items.l1: It is both fun and useful.
items.notes: Faithful; short sentence, so 又...又 vs 既...又 and the implicit subject swing the score; no change.

items.l1: These examples come from users.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's 是...的 and 那里 frame have no English counterpart, so the plain 来自 rendering scores low; no change.

items.l1: The company must write clear words and put them online.
items.notes: Faithful (要 = must, 清楚的话 = clear words); spread is only 写出/放到 synonyms; no change.

items.l1: Everyone can see them.
items.notes: Faithful; everyone renders both 每个人 and 大家 equally well and the object them is required in English; no change.

items.l1: Therefore, the wording must be simple and clear, avoiding words that are too technical.
items.notes: Same meaning; low score from Chinese synonym and register choices (文字/措辞, 要/必须, 词/词汇) that English cannot pin down; no change.

items.l1: I often wear it on weekends, or when I go out to play with friends.
items.notes: Faithful; gold repeats 穿 and uses 的时候 twice, which English naturally folds into one verb; no change.

items.l1: I think I will continue to like this T-shirt for a long time.
items.notes: Faithful; will continue covers 还会继续 and the score was already near the floor; no change.

items.l1: In very dry places, people have old methods of using water.
items.notes: Faithful and plain like the gold; spread is 很干/干旱 and 老/古老 register choices on the Chinese side; no change.

items.l1: The fields are in low places, so the water does not run away.
items.notes: Faithful; so makes the gold's implied cause explicit, which is standard, and the rest is 田/田地, 跑掉/流走 synonyms; no change.

items.l1: They help agriculture.
items.notes: Exact; three-word sentence, so 帮助农业 vs 对农业有帮助 moves the score a lot; no change.

items.l1: Even small children need to contribute their strength to the family.
items.notes: Faithful; 贡献一份力量 and 出一份力 are variants of the same set phrase; no change.

items.l1: Bees collect nectar from flowers, and pollen sticks to their bodies.
items.notes: Faithful; spread is 花里/花上 and the topic-comment form 身上会沾上花粉, both valid renderings; no change.

items.l1: The places where vegetables are grown also look very nice.
items.notes: Faithful (很好看 = look very nice); look pulls toward 看起来 and 漂亮 vs 好看, both valid; no change.

items.l1: Doing this well is good for the future.
items.notes: Faithful reading of 这样做好; spread is 将来/未来 and the gold's paratactic comma; no change.

items.l1: When the drought comes, they then use this water to irrigate the farmland.
items.notes: Faithful; English needs the subject they that the gold carries over, and 等到/把...用来 are structural; no change.

items.l1: In summary, yawning is far from a meaningless physiological reflex, but a multifunctional behavior that integrates temperature regulation, neural synchronization, and social communication.
items.notes: Faithful; only 沟通/交流 differ, and the score is just under the floor; no change.

items.l1: When many people take the bus, each person's carbon footprint is small.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's 坐公交的人多 vs ...的时候 is a valid structural variant; no change.

items.l1: Everyone commuting by bus is a good environmentally friendly habit.
items.notes: Faithful; spread is 公交/公交车 and 环保的好习惯 word order; no change.

items.l1: Within such a framework, telling a folk legend is not only recounting past events but, even more, performing a cultural practice: the speaker activates sacred time and space through language, while the listener, in immersion, gains a reaffirmation of identity.
items.notes: Loose: not merely...but read as a contrast (而是) and dropped the 更 of 不仅...更是, and folktale pointed to 民间故事; changed to not only...but, even more, and to folk legend (民间传说).

items.l1: This mechanism of "persistence amid variation" allows the cultural core to maintain spiritual continuity through changes in form.
items.notes: Faithful; at the floor because the coined quoted term has many Chinese renderings (变异中的存续 vs 变中有常); no change.

items.l1: In the contemporary era of globalization and digitization, although written records and visual media dominate the spread of information, oral narrative has not died out, but has returned in new forms: podcasts, oral history projects and movements to protect intangible cultural heritage can all be regarded as modern echoes of the original mode of communication.
items.notes: Faithful; at the floor only from long-sentence synonym spread (书面/文字, 影像媒介/视觉媒体, 形态/形式); no change.

items.l1: As early as the Tang dynasty, China had already widely used woodblock printing, and in the Song dynasty Bi Sheng even first invented clay movable type, opening the precedent for reusable typesetting technology.
items.notes: Faithful, and the names Tang, Song and Bi Sheng are correct; spread is the gold's literary register (便已, 应用, 首创); no change.

items.l1: Although they have never met, in the virtual world they have become very good partners.
items.notes: Loose: dropped the intensifier of 很好的伙伴; changed good partners to very good partners.

items.l1: This produces an upward force, which we call "lift."
items.notes: Faithful; spread is 这样就会 and 叫它/把它叫做, which are structural; no change.

items.l1: Drag makes the airplane slow down.
items.notes: Faithful; short sentence, so 会让...变慢 vs 让...慢下来 swings the score; no change.
